patch_description: This redesign uses a deterministic multi-start optimization pipeline instead of a fixed hand-built polyhedron.  Candidate point sets are initialized from several structured and seeded random layouts, then refined with a smooth log-distance min/max objective.  The optimizer uses annealed soft extrema, momentum-based updates, centering, and RMS normalization; it finally selects the candidate with the best exact minimum-to-maximum pairwise-distance ratio.
